# Martin Roll

> > Business strategy, leadership, and brand management consulting focused on Asia, emerging markets, and global brand development.

Martin Roll is a business advisor and thought leader specializing in Asian brand strategy, digital transformation, customer experience, and global expansion. His work spans luxury hospitality, retail branding, and emerging market strategies across China, India, Southeast Asia, and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Asian brand strategy
- Global branding and brand equity
- Digital transformation
- Customer experience and co-creation
- Leadership and thought leadership
- Emerging markets (China, India, Southeast Asia)
- Luxury brand management
- Retail branding and e-commerce
- Global expansion strategies
- Corporate rebranding
- Singapore Airlines brand excellence
- Mandarin Oriental hospitality
- Fast fashion and agile supply chains
- Brand building in Asia
- Keynote speaking and masterclasses
